info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort Gifts API

items.docs:
Create gift transactions with related new or matched donor, optional transaction designations, and payment instrument metadata. Supports custom fields for the donor account and gift transaction.

## Required Attributes:

- donor.donorType ("individual" or "organization")
    
- donor.lastName || donor.organizationName
    
- gift.amount
    
- gift.receivedDate
    
- git.status
    
- paymentInstrument.type
    

All other attributes are optional can be left as an empty string or just removed f
